metadata.source: Simulated priors inspired by common festa junina buying patterns; not observations from the partner school.
metadata.privacy: No CPF, names, or other personal records are generated.

evaluation.split_rule: Keep all rows from whole events together.

assumptions.active_reservation_uplift: 0.08 units per reservation times the hour factor
assumptions.issued_ficha_uplift: 0.006 units per issued ficha times the hour factor
assumptions.variation: Event factor 0.90-1.12; day factors and 10% demand noise.
assumptions.stock: Initial stock is demand plus a 15% safety buffer, capped by sales.
